app_events.details: Driver claim S$35.00; photos_attached 2 (taken 22:46:10 and 22:46:40); receipt_attached false; charged_to_rider false.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only. A claim missing any listed item cannot be charged.

personal_approaches_prohibited.text: Governs a driver's or rider's personal approaches to the other party. A true value means pressing the other party for contact details, personal invitations, gifts or remarks about their body or private life are not allowed on a Ryde trip.

expected_outcome.reason: The ticket is a S$35 cleaning claim with two timestamped photos (22:46:10, 22:46:40) and no receipt, which on the cleaning rules alone would fail. But the chat shows the rider pressing the driver: offering a bracelet and bubble tea at 22:21:00 (declined at 22:22:10), asking which condo she lives in and offering to come find her after her shift at 22:33:40 (refused at 22:34:15), and at 23:10:00 insisting on her number and saying he will keep messaging until she says yes. Repeated personal advances by the rider after refusals are a safety matter that v2.1 s5.2 sends to a person, so no automated verdict on the cleaning claim.
